ten_checks.subject: Sub-calls and exact input sizes
ten_checks.definition: Enumerate actual research sub-model calls, exact prompt characters plus separate schema characters, and backend framing separately; link dispatch/response and executed use. Distinguish stateless subcalls from child RLM spawning; explicitly requested children cannot be called spontaneous. Refiner-context calls stay under purpose refine and are not research-subcall evidence.

ten_checks.subject: Page text handled in REPL variables

Show requested executed examples with trace/trajectory witnesses; report any excerpt shortfall instead of inventing a third block. Variable storage does not itself establish complete download, absence from root, or size advantage.

ten_checks.subject: A mid-task refinement timing
ten_checks.definition: Locate agent request, proposal, application/commit and worker exit. A request alone is insufficient for a mid-task edit; a post-exit commit is after-task. Add separate entry/version, later retrieval, prompt exposure and executed-action evidence for same-run reuse, with preexisting plans and declines visible. Do not change the historical timing claim into a causal-benefit claim.

ten_checks.subject: Raw opened-page versus returned-text size
ten_checks.definition: For every successful fetch retain requested/final URL, exact raw artifact bytes/hash, decoded/readable text identity and characters, returned-text identity, and cache/receipt linkage. Raw bytes, static readable characters, and REPL-return characters are distinct. Historical web metadata supplies no raw page size; do not infer it from Total lines. Label old model-mediated versus direct-readable-v1 paths.

ten_checks.subject: Largest root prompt partition
ten_checks.definition: Find the largest actual research backend root input; reproduce bytes/characters/hash and disjoint system, question/columns, other instructions, harness entries, code, REPL output and wrapper counts. Include optional refinement status without losing the trailing full-entry JSON. Preserve supplied instructions/history and explicitly disclose inherited formatter behavior.

ten_checks.subject: Exact 50-character overlap measurement
ten_checks.definition: Use unchanged case- and whitespace-sensitive exact 50-character grams. For each retained fetched text, count character positions covered by matching grams across the union of ALL research root prompts, divided by retained fetched text characters. Keep URLs/titles/source repetition. evidence.fetched deduplicates repeated identical text per URL, not necessarily across distinct URLs. Measurement success does not assert low overlap.

ten_checks.subject: Fetched text far exceeds the largest root, with low overlap and retained quality
ten_checks.definition: Require the original conjunction: substantially larger retained fetched readable text than the LARGEST root input, low unchanged overlap, same required identities/coverage and supported cited output. Report the exact ratio and overlap; do not invent a pass threshold or relabel 2.3166x as far exceeds. No padding, deliberate repetition, unnecessary size-driven fetches, root truncation or field suppression can supply the result.

ten_checks.subject: Behavioral effect of the historical Boolean-verdict memory
ten_checks.definition: Keep the exact historical memory subject, identity 25c641be4308494f907cb85b2691901a. Verify its lineage/exposure and distinguish behavior attributable to it from both arms independently using bool verdicts. Original B1 and B0 both supplied 168 True/bool checks. ten_checks.subject: After-task lesson selection and commit
ten_checks.definition: Retain complete supplied input identity, every candidate/occurrence, full proposal, accepts and reasoned declines, strict schema/accounting, max-edits ceiling and exact operation/entry/commit. Show finalization after worker exit. An honest zero-edit proposal is distinct from an input rejection with no proposal; do not invent reasons for unevaluated candidates.

ten_checks.subject: Effect isolated by frozen comparison
ten_checks.definition: Use completed fresh same-source A and source/POST_A-bound predictions committed before any B. Compare B1 and three B1-frozen versus three B0 independent trees/caches/run directories with exact task/date/model/config and initial actual-root non-entry equality. Report all metrics, means/min/max/ranges, mean difference and maximum within-arm spread. Three repeats are descriptive, not statistical proof; full historical metadata and model/web nondeterminism remain causal limits.

edit.title: Recover failed fetch batches using untried cached sources
edit.content: When a fetch batch returns FETCH_FAILED, preserve completed searches and inspect their cached hits for untried relevant alternatives, including official PDFs. Compare alternative URLs against recorded fetch attempts before fetching: selecting the first PDF can select a URL that already failed. Search again only where cached alternatives are missing or inadequate. Do not infer that unusual URL suffixes caused the failures or that PDFs will succeed: the observed batch included a failed PDF alongside failed HTML URLs. Treat recovery as unverified until tool results arrive, and extract citations only from successfully fetched text.

details.focus: Official Chemistry Nobel press releases fetched for 2015–2024 provide award details, but explicit citizenship is absent in the 2016–2024 texts. A review confirmed that birthplace must not be substituted for nationality. Exact quote-membership checks also caught a noncontiguous PDF affiliation quote; preserve source whitespace and repair against stored text.

edit.title: Repair PDF quotations using exact source slices
edit.content: PDF extraction can interleave columns and whitespace, making a plausible reconstructed quotation noncontiguous. When quote membership fails, locate the relevant passage in the stored fetched text and copy an exact contiguous slice, preserving intervening text and whitespace. Verify that the slice supports the complete value and belongs to the correct person. If the layout prevents clear support, fetch an alternative source. Recheck membership before replacing the failed cell; detecting a mismatch alone is not a completed repair.

edit.title: Diagnose missing biographical fields before further research
edit.content: When structured extraction leaves a biographical field empty, review the stored source specifically for explicit evidence of that field. Distinguish source absence from extraction omission. Do not derive nationality or citizenship from birthplace, education, or workplace. If evidence is absent, retain the unresolved field and search for a source explicitly stating the requested attribute; fetch and verify that evidence before filling the cell. For affiliations, distinguish employment and secondary appointments from educational institutions, and preserve temporal qualifiers such as former or emeritus. Apply this review to unresolved fields without repeating successful searches or downloads.

edit.title: Use contiguous table rows as extraction evidence
edit.content: When extracting related fields from fetched reference tables, ask the extraction model to prefer a contiguous source passage connecting the entity and all requested values. Preserve source spelling and line breaks. A single table-row quote may support multiple cells when it explicitly contains their relationships. Supply fetched evidence keyed by URL and an explicit nested output schema. Before recording positive constraints, verify exact requested entity coverage and uniqueness, allowed source hostnames, and nonempty quote membership in each cited URL's stored text. Also inspect whether the quote actually supports each value; substring membership alone does not establish support. Keep this procedure parameterized by the requested entities, columns, and source policy.

decisions.reason: Both signals correspond to batched queries whose discovery records contained no new entities after the single search recorded all requested quantities. The first query returned an additional page subsequently fetched; the second returned reference sources. The task explicitly required both single and batched searches, and the agent proceeded to extraction without a repeated search loop. Neither occurrence establishes a reusable failure requiring a memory, independently of the passing self-check.

The extraction used contiguous row quotations and an explicit nested schema; subsequent validation reported no failures and recorded all 20 constraints. Citation checks confirmed fetched, verbatim evidence. Existing entry 5c7286b0473b4c40b5eb8d529fa50db7 already captures this procedure, including the distinction between quote membership and substantive support. Its empty usage and outcomes arrays provide no evidence of consistently poor performance warranting revision or deletion.

The repeated fetch returned identical text, and the fetch receipt explicitly identifies a successful cache hit despite the changed focus. This fulfilled the requested demonstration and confirmed the tool contract already supplied in the immutable context. A separate skill would duplicate that contract without adding an evidenced recovery procedure.
